title: Seaside
heading: UK seaside days out: towns, beaches and piers
intro: Sand, sea air, a pier to wander and an arcade or two along the front. Pick a seaside town, open its guide and see what is there: attractions, food stops, places to stay and the arcades along the prom. Check the town's own visitor information for tides, parking and event dates before you go.
tagline: Seaside towns, beaches and piers across the UK.
